svg.title: Two ways to connect brands: one tenant with several Active Directory forests, or several tenants managed from a hub
svg.desc: Two panels. Shape 1, one tenant: three brands each have their own Active Directory forest. One Microsoft Entra Connect Sync server that can reach all forests synchronizes them to one Microsoft Entra tenant. One landing zone covers all brands, and each brand has its own subscriptions. A domain name can be associated with only one tenant. Shape 2, several separate tenants: a corporate tenant and separate brand tenants, connected in both directions (each pair of arrows) by Azure Lighthouse and cross-tenant features. Because management groups and Azure Policy work inside one tenant, each tenant you govern needs its own landing zone deployment, and billing can still span tenants. A footer says to start with one tenant and add more only for requirements one tenant cannot meet. Icons are official: Microsoft Entra ID, Microsoft Entra Connect Sync and Azure Lighthouse.
